ads_enabled.description: Global master switch for all ads in the app

app_open_ads_enabled.description: Enable or disable App Open Ad on cold launch

banner_ads_enabled.description: Enable or disable Banner Ads in list screens and bottom bars

interstitial_ads_enabled.description: Enable or disable Interstitial Ads across navigation & call actions

native_ads_enabled.description: Enable or disable In-Feed Native Ads across all category screens

ad_show_probability.description: Probability threshold (0.0 to 1.0) for displaying ads
